title: Energy Truce Collapse and the AI Tech Wreck
description: Donald Trump denounces Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries after a unilateral energy ceasefire falls apart. Investors rotate out of mega-cap AI stocks and into government bonds and defensive equities, while weekend picks explore fungal networks and open-source radio engineering.

stories.title: Trump calls Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a ‘disgrace’
stories.summary: Donald Trump criticized Ukrainian strikes on Russian diesel refineries and attacked Volodymyr Zelenskyy following the breakdown of an energy ceasefire.

stories.title: Investors are dumping AI stocks as ‘tech wreck’ worsens. Here’s where they’re turning now.
stories.summary: A deepening tech selloff has pushed investors out of AI equities and into government bonds and defensive sectors amid capex monetization concerns.

stories.title: Major investment to take Skeleton's valuation over €1 billion
stories.summary: German technology group Siemens is investing at least €100 million in Estonian company Skeleton Technologies, raising its valuation to €1 billion.

stories.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
stories.summary: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

stories.title: Targeted ads delivered 0-click exploits to install mercenary malware
stories.summary: The incident is likely 1st confirmation of mercenary spyware delivered by targeted ads.

stories.title: W1700K SDR turns a Wi-Fi 7 router into a 320 MSps software-defined radio receiver
stories.summary: Developer h0m3us3r released an open-source project converting a Gemtek Wi-Fi 7 router into a wideband software-defined radio receiver.

stories.title: How Do Fungi Keep the Planet Healthy?
stories.summary: Biologist Toby Kiers outlined how complex fungal networks trade nutrients with plant roots and store subterranean carbon without a central brain.

stories.title: The ladder of knowledge
stories.summary: An essay by Alexander V Gheorghiu in Aeon explores the historical search for knowledge limits, framing truth as a dynamic concept.

stories.title: China protests Estonian politicians attending a Taiwanese event in Tallinn
stories.summary: China submitted a formal diplomatic protest to Estonia's parliament over lawmakers attending a Taiwanese National Day event in Tallinn.

stories.title: Ahead of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's launch next week, unionised Activision testers have voted to authorise a strike
stories.summary: Nearly 600 unionized Activision QA testers voted to authorize a strike right before the release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

stories.title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
stories.summary: Meta and Apple partnered to optimize the open-weight Muse Spark AI model for desktop Mac Studios using Apple's MLX framework.

stories.title: A new report just busted another myth about heat pumps
stories.summary: A report highlighted by Grist showed electrical grids possess sufficient capacity to support widespread heat pump adoption while cutting costs for ratepayers.
